data.name: Lily
data.gender_notes: Lily is used as a female name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Latin lilium, 'lily', a symbol of purity. Its root is Latin lilium. A Christian name; the lily is a symbol of purity. Lily is a Latin name meaning “Lily (flower); purity”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Lily expresses “Lily (flower); purity”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Latin lilium, 'lily', a symbol of purity.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Lily total 22, reducing to 4. Number 4 is associated with discipline, order and steady effort.
